mapping.note: SY = SX*H/W so pixels stay square; CX/CY centre the traced bbox on the origin

thicknessInference.note: both reference views are broadside; every Z value is an inference from knife construction, not a measurement

medallion.spokeNote: 4 brass spokes over a desaturated blue-grey inlay; inlay RGB measured [69,70,75] front / [71,75,77] back
